snippet_primary: "Gumroad's flat 10% transaction fee (plus processing fees) effectively penalizes growth. For a creator generating $50,000 annually, Gumroad claims over $5,000 in platform fees alone. In contrast, platforms like ThriveCart, which offer one-time payments, cap these costs, drastically increasing net revenue retention."
subject_exact: Argumento de ThriveCart: la fee flat de 10% de Gumroad (más processing) penaliza el crecimiento — un creador con $50,000 anuales paga más de $5,000 solo en platform fees — mientras plataformas de pago único como ThriveCart topean esos costos
metric_value_raw: over $5,000 in platform fees (creator generating $50,000 annually, flat 10%)
